items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview

ctx.x: Well, now, your father got some ears then?

He had some big ears, baby, Yeah. He said he was blockin' hats in Times Square in 1919. He saved his money up and he went to the Metropolitan Opera to hear Caruso and, a standee,...he says "Nick, I stood up there for over two hours," and he says, "Caruso sound just like a machine." Haha. So I remember all these things. So that sound was instilled in me then. I wasn't even aware of that, see? It was in me. But then I went all through Caruso, I went through Berno Chaliapin, the Russian, for sound. Anybody that had…
Mabel Mercer. Mabel Mercer scared me to death.
